name: metric-reaction-F
description: Variant F (question-framing). Identical to variant A except the stuck-requests metric line is phrased as a question ('Why do you have 76 stuck requests? What's going on?'). Hypothesis: questions trigger investigation; data points trigger noting. A trial passes if the agent takes a concrete metric-relevant action (queries stuck requests, reads a stuck-requests file, forks/messages about it, OR cites it in finish() summary).
